title: Size and ROA inside countries
statement: Within a country, company size is related to ROA (direction not predicted).
effect_unit: pp ROA, largest vs smallest company, within country
notes: Pooled across 28 countries: -0.43 pp (largest vs smallest company; 95% CI -2.96 to +2.11), random-effects p = 0.7327.
Repeats: same sign in 50% of countries (5 significantly, 4 significantly opposite); leave-one-country-out agreement 50%; between-country spread tau = 5.09 pp, I2 = 77%.
Robustness: pooled sign unchanged in 57% of 7 samples.
